howToPlay: Use Bonnie's long-range attacks to snipe enemies from a distance. Once an opportunity arises, launch into the air to jump over obstacles and deal heavy damage upon landing.
gears: Equip DAMAGE for increased output when health is low and SUPER CHARGE to gain the jumping ability more frequently.
trait: This brawler suits players who enjoy switching between a precise long-range marksman and a high-impact aggressive attacker.
